source.retrieval_method: GitHub connector; exact UTF-8 bytes; AST only, not executed
source.author: Gert Wohlgemuth

rules.entry: macd>0 and macd>macdsignal and bb_upperband>bb_upperband.shift(1) and rsi>70

evaluation.selection: availability-selected before candidate returns after prior 2023 QA failure

execution.position: spot long only; no leverage, shorting, funding or pyramiding
execution.entry_signal_time: only fully closed bar; lag1 executes at next native5m open; lag2 at second following open
execution.entry_and_signal_exit_price: signal bar close limit; improved fill at eligible open when marketable, else touch within eligible bar; fractional full fills assumed
execution.time_in_force: GTC with explicit strategy timeout cancellation at the end of one eligible 5m bar; no carryover
execution.buyhold: 95% of initial cash at first evaluation open, base fees and execution friction; no signals, ROI or stop
execution.ROI_target: net1% including both fees and cash friction: entry_price*(1+fee+friction)*1.01/(1-fee-friction)
execution.stop_trigger: entry_fill*0.75; gap below stop takes opening price
execution.stop_order: market risk-exit substitution; this differs from reference default limit and precludes strict reproduction
execution.intrabar_entry_policy: do not recognize same-bar ROI after intrabar limit entry; stop may still fire; open-filled entries permit stop then ROI
execution.terminal: mark existing position at last close; no forced liquidation; estimated liquidation net value separate
execution.friction_treatment: separate adverse cash cost, not a price fill outside the limit
execution.MDD: all105408 native5m close equities plus initial cash; daily display sampling is not MDD input
execution.Sharpe: UTC daily close returns, sqrt365, sample ddof1, rf0
execution.warmup_bootstrap: Initial account flat/cash; signal at evaluation index i comes from full-input index i-lag, including closed warmup-tail bars. lag1 first activation can use2023-12-31T23:55Z, lag2 can use23:50Z. No pre-evaluation position or order is carried.
execution.touch_comparisons: Limit touch/stop/ROI use inclusive<=or>=; raw source entry/exit indicator inequalities remain strict.
execution.cash_accounting: Entry budget=cash*.95; notional=budget/(1+fee+friction), qty=notional/fill; subtract budget. Exit proceeds=qty*fill*(1-fee-friction). Commission/friction reported separately at each fill; no borrowed cash.

resource_limits.configuration_scheduling: serial, release previous arrays before next configuration

execution.output_precision: CSV float17significant digits; JSON roundtrip float; no display rounding in full ledger
